=== backward branch to a named label
start:
        mov     r0, 0
        add     r0, r0, 1
        b       start
=== forward branch
        b       done
        mov     r0, 1
        mov     r1, 2
done:
        nop
=== conditional branches around a loop
loop:
        subs    r0, r0, 1
        bne     loop
        bgt     out
        cmp     r0, 0
        beq     loop
out:
        nop
=== numeric local labels
1:      add     r0, r0, 1
        cmp     r0, 16
        blt     1b
        b       2f
        nop
2:      nop
=== branch to an absolute expression
        b       . + 8
        nop
        nop
        b       . - 4
=== switching to thumb and back
        add     r0, r1, r2
        .thumb
        adds    r0, r1, r2
        movs    r3, 7
        .arm
        add     r0, r1, r2
=== mixing code and data
        mov     r0, 1
        .long   0x12345678
        .byte   1, 2, 3, 4
        mov     r1, 2
=== code 16 and code 32 select the instruction set
        add     r0, r1, r2
        .code   16
        adds    r0, r1, r2
        movs    r3, 7
        .code   32
        add     r0, r1, r2
=== alignment padding in arm code
        mov     r0, r0
        .balign 16
        mov     r0, r0
